description: Persist a partial patch to the shared Delx wellness profile (~/.delx-wellness/profile.json). REQUIRES explicit_user_intent=true. Top-level fields stored: profile (preferred_name, language, timezone, units, age_or_birth_year, height, weight, sex_or_gender_context), goals, devices, training, nutrition, preferences, safety, notes. NEVER stores OAuth tokens, API keys, refresh tokens, cookies, or any secret-shaped field — writes will be rejected at validation time. Cross-connector — the same profile is read by other Delx Wellness MCPs.

explicit_user_intent.description: Must be true. Set this AFTER the user has explicitly confirmed they want to save these changes to the shared wellness profile.

patch.description: Partial WellnessProfileDocument patch. Top-level keys may be: profile, goals, devices, training, nutrition, preferences, safety, notes.

name: garmin_profile_update
title: Garmin Profile Update (shared wellness profile)
